evaluation.overall_comment: The Icelandic translation preserves the structural outline of the original podcast script but suffers from major linguistic and technical deficiencies. While complete in coverage, the text requires extensive professional revision to meet the standards of contemporary Icelandic science communication before it can be used effectively for its intended audience.
